onboarding.title: 🎵 Lucky is ready to play
onboarding.description:
Join a voice channel and press **Start Listening**, or use `/play` with a song name or a Spotify link.

When the queue ends, Lucky keeps going with similar songs. `/247` keeps it in the voice channel between sessions.

After the first song, Lucky posts a Sunday recap of the server's most-played tracks and artists in the text channel where it was requested, if it can post there. A server admin can turn it off with the button on the recap or `/recap off`.
onboarding.reminderTitle: 🎧 Lucky hasn't played anything here yet
onboarding.reminderDescription:
It takes ten seconds: join a voice channel and press **Start Listening**, or use `/play` with a song name or a Spotify link.

This is the only reminder Lucky sends.

adminPrompt.title: One question for the admin
adminPrompt.description:
You manage this server, so this one is for you: what is Lucky missing to be the music bot here?

Answers go straight to the developer. Lucky asks this at most once a month.
